$note: FROZEN CONTRACT. Atlas builds against this shape. The engine emits this shape. Do not change field names without bumping the version.

epistemics.$note: Every value in this document carries a `state`. State drives MATERIAL in the UI. This is the core of the design.

states.observed: measured / reported inventory. Renders as METAL.
states.pledged: promised, projected or extrapolated. Renders as GLASS.
states.unknown: not yet parsed or not published. Renders as UNVERIFIED (hairline outline, no fill).
states.absent: confirmed not to exist. Renders as VOID (machined empty socket).

conditionality.statement: The majority of targets identified below are conditional on the international support.
conditionality.$note: Cambodia publishes NO numeric unconditional/conditional split. The dial MUST NOT invent one — render the conditional wheel as UNQUANTIFIED, floating and unmeshed, with the verbatim statement on the case-back.

finance_need.$note: Stated NEED, not receipt. 'over US$5.8 billion' / 'just over US$2 billion'.

btr.$note: Cambodia DID submit BTR1 on time. Per-component presence is NOT yet parsed — all eight are `unknown`, not `absent`. The UI must distinguish these: unknown = hairline outline, absent = machined void. Conflating them would be a false accusation.

series.$note: The observed series has ONE point. This is not a bug and must not be padded — it is exactly what the platform exists to expose. The engine's job is to fill this from EDGAR / Climate TRACE / the BTR inventory. Until it does, the dial renders a nearly-empty metal arc beside a full glass one, which is the honest picture.

derived.$note: Computed by the engine, never by the UI, so the number on screen and the number in an export can never disagree.
derived.$reason: avg annual change requires ≥2 observed years. With one point it is not computable. Do NOT display a gap factor — display the reason.
